title: FynnCloud App Manifest
description: Schema definition for FynnCloud application manifests (v1).

$schema.description: URI to this JSON schema for IDE validation and autocompletion.

id.description: Unique app identifier in kebab-case. Used for URLs, container names, and database schemas. Only lowercase letters, numbers, and single hyphens allowed.

name.description: Human-readable display name of the application.

version.description: Semantic Version (SemVer) of this release, e.g. 1.0.0.

description.description: A concise one-line summary of what the app does.

author.description: Name of the developer, organization, or community maintaining the app.

icon.description: Optional Iconify icon identifier fallback (e.g. "heroicons:calendar-days-solid"). Primary vector icon is automatically discovered from "icon.svg" in the app directory, which must be a monochrome SVG glyph using fill="currentColor".

gallery.description: Optional ordered list of image file names inside the app's gallery/ directory. By default every image in gallery/ is published, sorted by file name.

image.description: Docker container image reference (e.g. "ghcr.io/fynncloudproject/app-calendar:1.0.0"). The ':latest' tag is disallowed; an explicit version tag or digest must be specified.

category.description: Primary store category for the application.

oneOf.description: Set to false for headless daemons and background services without a web interface.

launcher.description: Whether the app appears in the primary navigation and app drawer. Defaults to true.

entrypoint.description: Optional subpath within the app to load as the initial UI entrypoint (e.g. "/dashboard" or "/web"). Defaults to "/".

sidebar.description: Custom navigation items rendered inside FynnCloud's native host sidebar while viewing this app.

id.description: Unique identifier for this sidebar item.

label.description: Human-readable label shown in the sidebar.

position.description: Section of the native sidebar where this item appears ('top_nav' above app drawer, 'bottom_nav' below app drawer).

target.description: Subpath route within the app iframe (e.g. '/' or '/events').

ui.description: UI, launcher, and native host sidebar configuration. Defaults to true (interactive app with launcher icon). Set to false for headless services.

api_version.description: Range of FynnCloud App API versions this release works with (see APP_API.md in the FynnCloud backend). Space-separated comparators using >=, >, <=, < or =, e.g. ">=0.1.0 <0.2.0". While the API is 0.x, pin a single minor. FynnCloud refuses to install or serve an app whose range excludes the server's API version.

database.description: When true or required, FynnCloud automatically provisions an isolated PostgreSQL database schema and credentials for the app.

storage.description: When true or volume_required, FynnCloud provisions an isolated persistent storage volume on the host.

drawer.description: Configuration for the bottom app drawer.

permissions.description: List of system scopes requested by the app.

events.description: Webhooks or real-time event subscriptions the app listens for.

hooks.description: System-wide integration hooks outside of the app's own UI (e.g. file browser context menu actions).

role.description: Set to 'open' if this app is the primary handler for opening this file type (triggered when single-clicking the file and promoted to 'Open' at the top of the context menu). Defaults to 'action'.

new_file.description: Hooks allowing an app to register options in FynnCloud's 'New' file creation menu.

id.description: Unique identifier for this new file action.

label.description: Human-readable label shown in the 'New' menu (e.g. 'Diagram').

default_filename.description: Default file name when creating (e.g. 'Untitled Diagram.drawio').

target.description: Subpath route within the app iframe (defaults to '/').

mode.description: Presentation mode for creating the file ('modal' for overlay editor, 'navigate' for full page app).

deploy.description: Container deployment and hardware specifications for Docker/container runners.

image.description: Docker container image reference (e.g. "ghcr.io/fynncloudproject/app-calendar:1.0.0"). The ':latest' tag is disallowed; an explicit version tag or digest must be specified.

port.description: Internal HTTP port exposed by the container (defaults to 8080).

path.description: HTTP endpoint path for health checks.

env.description: Default environment variables to inject into the container.
